summary: 1-800-Flowers.com filed an 8-K disclosing a September 26, 2026 Asset Purchase Agreement to sell its Personalization Mall, Things Remembered, and Personalization Universe businesses to PlanetArt, LLC for $45.0 million cash, subject to working capital and other adjustments. The company acts as seller; no board recommendation or advisor is named in the excerpt. Closing conditions include no Business Material Adverse Effect, accuracy of reps and warranties, and specified third-party consents. Ancillary commercial and transition services agreements are contemplated. The deal terms as stated are a $45 million all-cash purchase price, with no per-share metric given.
